question: Is the existing ChatGPT-subscription engine's real streaming behavior expressible as a declarative provider descriptor, per PLUG-D23's Stage-2 conformance requirement?
extracted_from: sidecar/ai/engines/provider_http.py (shared status/retry policy this engine delegates to)
services/backend/chatgpt-auth-service.js (auth_profile shape and OAuth client id only)
redaction_note: Every credential-shaped value in this directory is a synthetic placeholder declared in a fixture's own 'constants' block (e.g. ACCESS_TOKEN) or an opaque descriptive string; no value copied from a real account, token, or provider response appears anywhere under this directory. This is mechanized, not promised: scripts/checks/check_provider_descriptor_fixtures.py fails on any file whose bytes match a bearer or JWT shape, which is why header templates read 'Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}' rather than carrying a literal.

runner.note: Every executable case names one binding from a closed vocabulary and is run against the REAL engine by the conformance suite; the mutation suite then perturbs every leaf of every expectation and requires each mutant to fail, so no adapter can be a silent no-op. Adding a fixture without registering it here fails the gate, and so does dropping the executable case count below minimum_executable_cases.

files.streams/finalized_text_recovery.json: terminal two-buffer text resolution (generic, not chatgpt-specific)
files.streams/tool_call_lifecycle.json: CARVE-OUT: cross-request reasoning-item replay cache, plus its bounds and FIFO eviction order
files.streams/tool_call_argument_edge_cases.js: per-item coercion, the per-stream duplicate guard, and the whole-list pairing filter
files.streams/error_taxonomy.json: strongest 'yes': the initial-status table (delegated to the shared provider policy) and the in-stream response.failed table
files.streams/incomplete_and_malformed.json: terminal-reason table, generic SSE framing tolerance, and the bounded ignored-event diagnostics
files.request/input_items_mapping.json: chat-history-to-input-items mapping, the static request envelope, and the function-tool template
files.model_catalog.json: static catalog with a version + provenance stamp, plus the plan-vs-implementation gap note
files.descriptor/descriptor.draft.json: draft descriptor attempt: metadata, auth-profile shape, endpoints, headers, carve-outs, security-property confirmation
files.descriptor/stream_event_map.draft.json: the full per-event-type mapping table, the heart of the descriptor

verdict_summary: route confirmed with named carve-outs (see verdict doc section 3)
